verdict.rationale: Glama's chat product (glama-docs-17..23) lets users interact naturally in text with AI models, and the MCP inspector/gateway are configured via UI/JSON rather than natural-language commands. There is no evidence that core platform actions (deploying servers, managing gateway policies, hosting config) can be driven by natural-language commands. missing for 10: NL command interface for registry/hosting/gateway management, evidence of conversational control over platform operations beyond chat with models.
